scope: Native FiniteSet local lambda consumers and deferred array defaults; 186-input validation subset, not a full-corpus rerun.
changes: Register set.filter predicate arguments through theory::is_beta_redex.
Defer lambda-default axioms when all relevant uses are non-array pointwise consumers; retain default axioms for escaping lambdas and ordinary array uses.
Propagate existing base memberships to newly created set operations; exclude singleton elements from base-set propagation.
